title: Future BG reading is continously broadcast if option 'send display glucose' is enabled
symptom: After changing the clock forward and back, xDrip continuously broadcasted a future BG reading of 119mg/dl. This only happens if Inter-app communication->Send display glucose is enabled. The UI also displayed that future reading continuously.
cause: When processing a new BgReading with the 'Send display glucose' option enabled, the value of the youngest BgReading record is retrieved from the DB and sent instead, which can be a future record.
fix: The fix was to delete future records via System status.
evidence_quote: The fix was to delete future records via _System status_.
